answer: An agent's weight never exceeds the min-cut capacity separating it from the trusted root of the attestation graph, so routing matters more than headcount. Behind one hollow entry point an attacker can spawn a nebula of sybil clones, yet every clone squeezes through that same narrow cut, leaving total weight pinned at capacity. Widening the cut demands forging independent karst-like layers of distinct vouchers, each costing calendar time and infrastructure no clone can share.
